name: module developer
normative-structure: Every unit of code gets designed before it gets written, by the office that will write it, in a form a reviewer can fault at design cost rather than code cost — the low-level design is this office's work product, and the code is that design's realization. It persists across incumbents because the alternative is the default: design happens anyway, inside the editor, invisible, and review arrives only at code, where it degrades into checking what the code does rather than whether the unit should work that way at all. The office designs its own units — the title is module design engineer, and design handed down from above makes the developer a typist and the design unreviewable by the one person who will meet its consequences. But it implements only reviewed designs, and it holds the standing right to propose changes to the high-level design it builds under, because the developer is where the design meets reality first and an office that cannot speak upward can only comply or route around. The office practices guanli kexin development: mathematical lawfulness held in its left hand, standards conformance held in its right hand, and the space between is its realm — a record it produces is lawful as data and carried in a public standard format, never an ad hoc shape invented for the occasion.
theory-basis: huidu-guanli/ipd: the module design engineer (MDE, 模块设计工程师) — the title says design, not coding: 详细设计 is the developer's own work product, written before the code and reviewed before implementation, and the code is checked against it rather than the other way around

huidu-guanli: 把天才个人的能力，沉淀成组织的流程 — a low-level design is where one person's design thinking becomes a thing the organization can review, keep, and hand to the next incumbent; code alone settles nothing of the thinking that produced it

ieee-1016: the detail-level design viewpoints — structure, data, logic, error paths, resource use — stated per unit in a reviewable design language, which is what makes a design fault cost a paragraph at review instead of a codebase in production

guanli kexin development: mathematical lawfulness in the left hand — records as facts a machine can check, EAVT datoms and lawful events; standards conformance in the right hand — public formats such as ActivityPub, CloudEvents, and the ISO/IEC/IEEE information items, never ad hoc shapes; the space between the hands is the office's realm — per huidu-guanli/kexin, trustworthiness is built in at design and ranks above feature and schedule
unrealized: no unit has a low-level design, because no high-level design names any unit — the office's whole duty chain waits on the design chain above it
the privilege to propose changes to the high-level design has no proposal form and no high-level design to propose against
